verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Devin can be triggered from Linear/Jira tickets and Slack/Teams threads, and Devin Review integrates with PRs on GitHub/GitLab-style workflows, but there is no explicit documentation of directly kicking off a task from a GitHub or GitLab issue/PR comment (only PR review automation is described), and no independent/hands-on confirmation of these trigger flows. missing for 10: explicit GitHub/GitLab issue-triggered task creation, independent confirmation of Slack/Linear triggering working in practice.
